purpose: G2's own cases: each justifies one canonicalization exclusion, or proves an exclusion was NOT made. Kept separate from G0's frozen corpus so G0's digest and acceptance stay valid.

cases.subject: package:corpus/app.dart::usesPrivate
cases.note: JUSTIFIES body exclusion #2. A local's name is not observable, so encoding locals by binding ordinal is safe. Compared against g2_local_base rather than base, because base writes the member as an arrow expression with no local at all -- comparing against it would measure a shape change, not a rename.

cases.subject: package:corpus/app.dart::usesPrivate
cases.note: PROVES order is NOT excluded. Execution order is observable, so the body fingerprint must move. If this case reported body_equal the canonicalizer would be discarding something that changes behaviour.

cases.subject: package:corpus/app.dart::Box
cases.dimension: a type parameter is renamed T -> S
cases.note: JUSTIFIES the ABI exclusion. A type parameter's name is not observable at a call site; position and bound are what a caller depends on.
